item.title: Lawrence high school students protest ICE detainments
item.description: A week after ICE detained five people in Lawrence, high school students protested at the corner of Ninth and Massachusetts streets Tuesday, saying the local ICE activity made speaking out even more important. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas advocates push again for more affordable period products
item.description: Young people gathered Tuesday in the Kansas Statehouse to show their support for bills that would make it easier to obtain period products. But they were in the same place last year. And the year before that. Continue reading ...

item.title: Opponents of proposed ICE detention center in Leavenworth make final push as vote nears
item.description: Tensions ran high in Leavenworth Tuesday evening. Protesters gathered outside city hall as city leaders considered a private prison company’s application to house immigration detainees in the historic prison town. Continue reading ...

item.title: Former police officer injured during Capitol riot to speak in Lawrence, hold rally
item.description: Michael Fanone, a former Washington, D.C. police officer who was injured in the Jan. 6 riots at the Capitol, will soon give a talk in Lawrence before holding a rally in South Park. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Bellamy has abiding love of humans, boopable nose
item.description: Even after 161 days at the Lawrence Humane Society with little reprieve, boopable Bellamy goes through life with a huge, happy grin. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU plans slate of public events to celebrate Kansas Union centennial
item.description: KU will celebrate a century of the Kansas Union with events open to the public, including glow-in-the-dark mini golf and a bowling alley, a casino night and cake galore. Continue reading ...

item.description: "The top 3 books are all local authors who presented incredible readings for their new titles. Keep your eyes peeled for the March event announcements and April's events (which are completely stacked)," the Raven Book Store writes. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence can celebrate the arrival of spring at CREES’ Spring Festival
item.description: There will be no shortage of bliny at this weekend’s Spring Festival, hosted by KU’s Center for Russian, East European and Eurasian Studies. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas House dramatically amends bill aimed at constraining local property tax increases
item.description: The Kansas House voted Wednesday to alter significant provisions of a bipartisan property tax reform bill granting the public a direct voice in decisions by local government to raise property taxes more than 3% annually. Continue reading ...

item.title: Planning commissioners recommend annexing 63 acres in northwestern Lawrence
item.description: Planning commissioners on Wednesday voted to recommend annexing property west of Lawrence Nature Park into city limits for a potential housing development. Continue reading ...
